_comment: "Defense reaction cards can't be played this chain link." combat.no_defense_reactions is READ in four places (play.py's reaction-step offer and _defense_reaction_legal_check; actions.py for hand and arsenal) and was SET BY NOTHING. All three cards with this text wrote a dead SET_FLAG instead -- under TWO different names -- so they looked implemented and blocked nothing. Same shape as DamageEvent.unpreventable: the reader existed, the writer did not. This is an Action-Attack card, not a defense reaction: its ability_type was DEFENSE_REACTION, which is a different card kind and offered it in the wrong step. The clause applies while it is the attack, so it is an ON_ATTACK trigger. Stealth is printed and fires from the card DB.
